title: The knight
line: The only piece that jumps. Reach any square in the fewest moves.

steps.text: The knight moves in an L: two squares in a straight line, then one to the side. It always lands on the other color.
The knight jumps over pieces in its way. Tap every square the knight on b1 can reach.
steps.after: It jumps over the pawns in front of it.

steps.text: In a corner the knight reaches very little. Tap every square this knight can reach.
steps.after: From the corner, only two squares. A knight in the middle reaches eight.

steps.text: The knight on e2 cannot capture the pawn on e6 at once. Tap every square from which a knight could capture it.
steps.after: Those are the squares a knight's jump away from e6.

steps.text: Now jump to one of those squares in one move.

also.e1d2: That is a sound move, but it does not put the knight a jump away from e6.
